title: BMW Finance - Example
effect: Customer dissatisfaction with wear and tear and residual value

causes.text: Vehicle assessors do not inform customers about the next steps.
causes.hint: Focus on communication by the assessor. This example places this under People.

causes.text: The independent assessor is considered biased.
causes.hint: This concerns the customer's perception of the assessor's impartiality.

causes.text: The dealership assessor estimates residual value lower than the value shown later in the official letter.
causes.hint: This example groups this discrepancy with the assessor-related causes under People.

causes.text: Customers receive no information about signs of use and decreased vehicle value.
causes.hint: Think about information that should be communicated during the process. This example places this under Procedure.

causes.text: Customers receive no information about how residual value is calculated.
causes.hint: This is a missing explanation in the customer-facing process.

causes.text: Evaluation of damage takes too long.
causes.hint: This example groups this processing delay under Systems.

causes.text: The return protocol is sent by mail or fax, with no electronic distribution.
causes.hint: Focus on the channels used to distribute information.
This example places errors in the return protocol under Systems.

causes.text: Goodwill allowances for wear and tear are handled too strictly.
causes.hint: Think about the rules governing allowances and exceptions.

causes.text: The return protocol, including damage information, is sent to customers too late.
causes.hint: Although timing could fit other categories, this example places this under Policy.

causes.text: Competitors offer vouchers for car damage or insurance.
Customers do not understand the acronyms in the return protocol.
causes.hint: This example places this under Equipment. Communication or document design could also be reasonable discussion points.

causes.text: Documents are incomplete when sent to SF.
causes.hint: Follow this example: this document-related cause appears under Equipment.

sub_causes.text: Calculation of residual value takes longer.
sub_causes.explanation: The slide draws this as a smaller branch connected to the incomplete-documents entry. The intended causal direction should be confirmed with the professor.
